name: manual_3e674e
claim: Treat lock cleanup as an ownership-sensitive write: if the nonce or state no longer belongs to the caller, close its descriptor without replacing the changed record or clearing ambiguity.

decisions.notes: Final independent review of Orama PR487 found recheck refusal followed by not-sent release could erase changed owner evidence; regression and remediation recorded in the paired dated POSIX domain record.
